chars.BILAL: BILAL: a Moroccan man in his late twenties with short black hair and a trimmed black beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark grey jogging trousers
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman with very long wavy black hair, wearing a long-sleeved lilac satin pyjama set with white piping

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in a small cosy apartment living room in Rabat lit by candles. SALMA, with an angry wild expression, drives her knee hard into BILAL's stomach; BILAL bends forward in pain and shock, eyes wide. Both characters in the centre of the frame, full bodies visible, calm dark background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same candle-lit Rabat living room. BILAL has fallen back on a Moroccan sofa, terrified; SALMA is leaning over him pinning his shoulders, her eyes rolled back showing only white, her long hair wild. Creepy but not gory, both in the centre.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SALMA stands in the middle of the dark living room screaming with her mouth wide open, face pale yellowish, eyes white, hair floating, candles flickering; BILAL crouches in the corner covering his ears in fear. Both in the central area.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of BILAL frozen against the wall, sweating, mouth open in total confusion, looking at SALMA who is twisting her body strangely in the foreground, seen from behind with wild hair. Night, candle light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BILAL holds his head with both hands, panicking and trembling, thinking she is possessed; behind him in the shadows SALMA crouches on the carpet staring at him with white eyes. Dark blue night atmosphere, Moroccan apartment.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SALMA throws herself around on the living room carpet, rolling and thrashing; a cushion and a small tea table are knocked over; BILAL stands back with arms raised in panic. Both full bodies in the centre.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: SALMA walks into a small Moroccan kitchen at night with tiled walls and grabs a big kitchen knife from the wooden knife block, her back slightly hunched, eyes white, moonlight from the window. She is in the centre of the frame.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the dark living room, SALMA points the big kitchen knife toward BILAL and shouts with a deep scary expression; BILAL backs away against the door, hands up, terrified. Tense standoff, both in the centre, no blood.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: BILAL on his knees on the carpet, crying and begging with joined hands, tears on his cheeks; SALMA towers over him holding the knife at her side, eyes white, candles behind. Both in the centre of the frame, no blood.
